nust.name: NUST IC-Engine Journal-Bearing Vibration Dataset
nust.role: Reciprocating IC-engine vibration behavior and journal bearing fault signatures under climatic variations
nust.access_requirement: Open access (Mendeley Data). Cloudflare web protection may require manual browser download.
nust.verified_total_size: 254.4 MB (11.4 MB processed ZIP + 243 MB raw ZIP)
nust.automation_status: SEMI_AUTOMATED (Direct API attempted; falls back to MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED on session lock)
nust.source_measurement_confidence: HIGH (Direct tri-axial physical accelerometer on MIL-STD-810G climatic chamber IC engine)
nust.target_transfer_confidence: MEDIUM (Physical reciprocating IC-engine mechanics; automotive/industrial bearing, not aero-piston flight unit)
nust.notes: Version 5 authoritative archive. Reciprocating IC-engine test bench with thermal/humidity chamber controls.

paderborn.name: Paderborn University Bearing Dataset
paderborn.role: Mechanical bearing fault signatures, vibration distributions, speed/load sensitivity, and damage-type evidence
paderborn.access_requirement: Open academic research access via Zenodo archive.
paderborn.format: MATLAB (.mat) 64 kHz vibration & synchronous motor current
paderborn.verified_total_size: 4.95 GB (verified size of the specific Zenodo 15845309 archive/mirror across 31 .rar files; not necessarily the canonical Paderborn website dataset size)
paderborn.core_profile_size: ~490 MB (representative healthy, outer fault, inner fault runs)
paderborn.automation_status: FULLY_AUTOMATED for core and full collection via Zenodo REST API
paderborn.source_measurement_confidence: HIGH (Calibrated test rig with synchronized 64 kHz piezo sensors)
paderborn.target_transfer_confidence: MEDIUM (Component-level bearing mechanics; electric motor test bench, not engine block)

damage_type_taxonomy.severity_assessment: SEPARATE (measured extent in mm/depth vs. derived vibration metric, NOT conflated with damage_type)

paderborn.notes: Authoritative Zenodo 15845309 mirror archive. Used for mechanical fault signatures and vibration distributions; NOT an engine RUL dataset.

cwru.name: CWRU Bearing Data Center
cwru.role: Rotational bearing fault harmonic orders, defect geometry relationships, and operating load sensitivity
cwru.license: Open Academic Benchmark (No formal SPDX header on source page)
cwru.automation_status: FULLY_AUTOMATED (Direct HTTP file retrieval with checksum verification)
cwru.target_transfer_confidence: MEDIUM (Component-level bearing fault evidence only; steady-state induction motor rig)
cwru.notes: Standard rotating machinery benchmark for bearing defect frequencies and harmonic progression.

femto.name: FEMTO / PRONOSTIA Bearing Degradation Dataset
femto.role: Accelerated run-to-failure degradation progression, health index monotonicity, and RUL trajectory methodology
femto.mirror_provenance: Academic research repository reproducing original IEEE PHM 2012 challenge bearing signals
femto.license: Open Academic Benchmark (IEEE PHM 2012 Challenge Rules; redistributed on NASA/GitHub mirrors without formal SPDX tag)
femto.access_requirement: Open access on GitHub/NASA mirrors; IEEE DataPort requires IEEE account login.
femto.format: CSV files (horizontal & vertical acceleration @ 25.6 kHz, sampled every 10s)
femto.automation_status: FULLY_AUTOMATED via verified GitHub/NASA repository mirror; MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED for IEEE portal
femto.source_measurement_confidence: HIGH (Controlled accelerated life test bench with continuous high-frequency logging)
femto.target_transfer_confidence: LOW_TO_MEDIUM (Methodological transfer for degradation curve shapes and monotonicity; bearing RUL != engine RUL)
femto.notes: Used strictly for degradation trajectory shape, monotonicity, and RUL uncertainty methodology.

cmapss.name: NASA C-MAPSS Simulated Turbofan Degradation Dataset
cmapss.role: NASA C-MAPSS simulated turbofan degradation dataset; used only for prognostic/degradation methodology and trajectory-shape evidence.
cmapss.mirror_provenance: Academic research mirror hosting identical CMAPSSData archive with SHA-256 validation
cmapss.license: License not explicitly specified on current NASA data portal page (NASA Open Data policy typically applies to US Government works, but explicit SPDX license header is absent on current portal)
cmapss.format: Space-delimited ASCII text files (.txt) inside compressed archive
cmapss.verified_total_size: 11.8 MB compressed (~120 MB uncompressed text files)
cmapss.automation_status: FULLY_AUTOMATED (Direct archive retrieval with checksum verification)
cmapss.target_transfer_confidence: LOW (Purely methodological RUL/degradation transfer; C-MAPSS variables MUST NEVER be mapped to aero-piston CHT/EGT)
cmapss.notes: Dedicated evidence adapter extracts degradation trajectory curvature and RUL bounds only. Zero direct channel mapping.

basic.name: BASiC: Biomisa Arducopter Sensory Critique Dataset
basic.role: UAV flight mission phases, timestamp behavior, and sensor failure profiles (bias, drift, stuck, noise)
basic.format: RAR archives containing ArduPilot SITL flight logs (.bin, .txt, .mat, .csv)
basic.nature_of_data: SITL (Software-in-the-Loop) ArduPilot simulation data with engineered sensor failures, NOT physical UAV flight measurements
core_profile_files: DataFlash Text Logs.rar (~727 MB) or selected sample flights
basic.automation_status: FULLY_AUTOMATED for individual archive retrieval via Zenodo REST API
basic.target_transfer_confidence: HIGH for flight mission context and sensor-failure kinematics; LOW for propulsion (electric vs. piston)
basic.notes: SITL simulation logs across 70 autonomous flight instances. Electric motor telemetry is strictly ignored.

nasa_battery.name: NASA PCoE Battery Aging Dataset
nasa_battery.role: Electrochemical capacity degradation, internal resistance increase, SOH methodology under temperature cycles
nasa_battery.mirror_provenance: Public repository hosting original B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018 cycle records
nasa_battery.license: License not explicitly specified on current NASA data portal page (NASA Open Data policy typically applies to US Government works, but explicit SPDX license header is absent on current portal)
nasa_battery.format: MATLAB (.mat) / CSV charge-discharge cycle records (B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018)
nasa_battery.verified_total_size: ~28.6 MB (Complete set of 4 benchmark Li-ion batteries)
nasa_battery.automation_status: FULLY_AUTOMATED via official endpoint or verified academic mirror
nasa_battery.target_transfer_confidence: LOW_TO_MEDIUM (Methodological SOH capacity fade transfer; NOT direct engine alternator degradation)
nasa_battery.notes: Used strictly for capacity fade and health index degradation methodology.
